[*] Modified the lobby room code with hidden status for streamers

Crock Kid:

Introducing Crock Kid! the resilient boy who calls the Australian swamps his home. Born amidst the tangled mangroves and murky waters, Crock Kid's unique upbringing has endowed him with extraordinary abilities. With an agile prowess, he leaps through the swampy terrain, landing jaw-crushing blows with his powerful bite. A true master of the jump-and-crack technique, Crock Kid navigates the treacherous landscapes with ease, leaving his foes in awe and fear. Watch out for this swamp-bred dynamo, as he leaps into action, ready to unleash his powerful jaws on any challenger foolish enough to cross his path.

Happy delivery!!
